source:
Maya: This guard is enough for the profile cache. If there is no user, returning the cached profile avoids another network call.
```ts
if (!user) return cachedProfile;
return fetchProfile(user.id);
```
Leo: That returns someone else's cachedProfile when user is null after logout. The safe behavior is to return null or clear the cache, not show the previous account.
Maya: The cache is scoped by tab, so I do not think it crosses accounts.
Leo: Logout in the same tab is exactly the crossing case I am worried about.

extraction.mainQuestion: Is returning cachedProfile safe when user is null?

positions.label: Guard is safe
positions.thesis: Returning cachedProfile when user is null is safe enough and avoids a network call.
positions.steelman: If the cache is scoped correctly, the guard prevents unnecessary fetching without leaking data.

groundingQuotes.quote: This guard is enough for the profile cache.

positions.label: Guard leaks prior profile
positions.thesis: Returning cachedProfile when user is null is unsafe because logout in the same tab can show the previous account.
positions.steelman: A null user state should not display cached account data after logout.

groundingQuotes.quote: That returns someone else's cachedProfile when user is null after logout.

claims.statement: The profile cache is scoped so returning cachedProfile does not cross accounts.

resolution.condition: Run the logout-in-same-tab case or inspect cache scoping.

groundingQuotes.quote: The cache is scoped by tab, so I do not think it crosses accounts.

claims.statement: Logout in the same tab can make the guard show the previous account.

resolution.condition: Test the guard after logout in the same tab.

groundingQuotes.quote: Logout in the same tab is exactly the crossing case I am worried about.

disagreementCandidates.question: Can the null-user guard show a previous account's cached profile?
disagreementCandidates.summary: Maya thinks cache scoping makes the guard safe; Leo says same-tab logout exposes the bug.

participantStances.stance: The guard is safe because the cache is scoped.
The guard can show the previous account after logout.

disagreementCandidates.resolutionCondition: Reproduce the same-tab logout case or inspect cache invalidation.
